remarks: Location, Location, Location! Sunny downtown Stamford apartment with city views from the 7th-floor balcony! Originally a studio, thoughtfully redesigned with a partition wall to create the feel of a separate bedroom space with its own window. Features hardwood floors in the living room and bedroom area, updated bath, dressing area, and two large closets offering excellent storage. Eat in kitchen! Enjoy the convenience of walking to restaurants, shopping, theater, library, and the train station. Building amenities include laundry and gym in the basement, plus beautifully maintained park-like grounds. This is the one you've been waiting for! Schedule your tour today!
